metadata.name: trading
metadata.description: Trading program for P2P Energy Trading - Order book and marketplace

instructions.name: submit_limit_order
docs: Submits a limit order and attempts immediate matching against the order book

instructions.name: submit_market_order
docs: CDA Market Order - Execute immediately at best available price

instructions.name: update_depth
docs: This instruction updates the buy/sell side depth arrays based on current orders

instructions.name: update_price_history
docs: Update price history with new trade data
Maintains rolling 24-hour price history and calculates VWAP

errors.name: NotValidatedForTrading
errors.msg: ERC certificate not validated for trading

errors.name: ExceedsErcAmount
errors.msg: Order amount exceeds available ERC certificate amount

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: Slippage exceeded: Price outside allowed bounds

types.name: BatchInfo
docs: Batch information for grouped order execution

fields.name: owner
docs: Current owner of the certificate (for transfers)

fields.name: renewable_source
docs: Source of renewable energy (solar, wind, etc.) - FIXED: 64 bytes

types.name: Market
docs: Market account for order and trade management

fields.name: min_energy_amount
docs: Minimum energy amount for ERC issuance (kWh)

fields.name: require_oracle_validation
docs: Require oracle validation for ERC issuance

fields.name: delegation_enabled
docs: Whether the authority can delegate ERC validation

fields.name: oracle_authority
docs: Oracle authority for AMI data validation

fields.name: min_oracle_confidence
docs: Minimum confidence score for oracle validation (0-100)

fields.name: pending_authority_proposed_at
docs: When the pending authority change was proposed

fields.name: pending_authority_expires_at
docs: When the pending authority change expires (48 hours)

types.name: ZoneMarket
docs: Zone Market account for tracking order book depth in a specific geographic zone.
This allows order book depth mapping to be sharded out of the main Market account,
preventing write lock contention on the global state when different zones are trading.
